summary: Universal Corp filed an 8-K on October 13, 2026, reporting that on October 9, 2026 it executed Amendment No. 1 to its Credit Agreement dated December 9, 2025 with JPMorgan Chase Bank as Administrative Agent and lender parties. The amendment raises the maximum Total Net Leverage Ratio covenant from 3.00:1.00 to 3.75:1.00 for fiscal quarters ending September 30 and December 31, 2026, 3.25:1.00 for March 31, 2027, reverting to 3.00:1.00 thereafter. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; no board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms beyond covenant levels. Watch leverage headroom and potential covenant pressure.
